steps: Open Finance.
Create the invoice for the family / term lines you need.
Share the link (WhatsApp / email) using the portal send tools.
Track status until paid or followed up.
tips: Keep finish-booking copy free of suitability wording.

es.title: Crear y compartir una factura
es.summary: Monta una factura de familia en Finance y manda el enlace de pago o de ver.
steps: Abre Create invoice. El titulo de la pantalla es Create invoice, no Finance.
Busca el contacto, elige al participante, el modo de VAT, el importe, la cantidad y el vencimiento.
Los campos de LA salen cuando el modo es LA / NHS. Mid-term y la subida del PDF van cerrados hasta que los abras.
Comparte el enlace por WhatsApp o email con las herramientas del portal.
Sigue el estado hasta que este pagada o hasta el siguiente aviso.
tips: En el texto del enlace de finish-booking no pongas frases de suitability.
Create invoice y Xero products no son los tres botones de la fila de Finance. Esos tres son Re-enrolments, Payments y Absents.

lessons.title: Validate / mark paid
lessons.summary: Confirm payment so the family and ops state match.
steps: Open the invoice or payment row.
Confirm bank / Stripe payment as your process requires.
Mark paid / validate so re-enrol and booking status update.
If a finish-booking trial was waiting, check Overview for the first session date.

es.title: Validar / marcar pagado
es.summary: Confirma el pago para que la familia y la oficina coincidan.
steps: Abre la fila de la factura o del pago.
Confirma el pago de banco o de Stripe segun el camino.
Mark paid / valida para que re-enrolment y el estado de la reserva se actualicen.
Si un trial de finish-booking estaba esperando, mira Overview en la fecha de la primera sesion.
Despues de una transferencia, el padre tiene que avisar a la oficina. Un toque en el enlace no marca el pago solo.
tips: Payment Link es una factura marcada como payment link que esta pagada o pagada en parte. Un enlace sin pagar no cuenta.

lessons.title: Absents, refunds and credits
lessons.summary: Decide missed sessions: no action, credit, refund path, or close.
steps: One day with no instructor: Schedule and Covers, that date, Change on the child's card, then Cancelled. Do not use Absent. Absent is the family missing the session.
In Reason write that there is no instructor. Do not ask them to reply on this message. Save. That day only is cancelled. The standing service stays.
The parent gets an automatic WhatsApp that the session is cancelled, including that note. It says the message was sent automatically. The row lands in Absents, refunds and credits.

When the family tells the office refund or credit another way, open that row. Choose Credit or Refund, then Approve. For a refund enter the session amount. For a credit enter the same amount, or leave the amount blank for a session credit with no cash figure.
Approve writes the family ledger and sends the outcome message. Makeup is only if they ask for another day.
tips: Sep+ absents and cancellations share one decide queue.
Automatic API messages (instructor change, time change, cancel, makeup confirm) say they were sent automatically. Do not ask the parent to reply on them.

Private pay-in-advance cancellation: unused prepaid can be refunded with a fee of 10% of the unused amount (minimum £25, maximum £100). Sessions already delivered, including a summer crash course, stay paid. LA / NHS do not use this fee.

Cancelling the standing place is Edit term slot. Set the anchor to a date on that weekday, then Rest of term from the anchor. The refund told to the parent is written under that participant, Payments, Cancel refund, and on this ledger. Mark paid back when that money has gone back. The programme payments row still shows what they paid in.

es.title: Faltas, reembolsos y creditos
es.summary: Decide las sesiones perdidas: nada, credito, camino de reembolso, o cerrar.
steps: Un dia sin instructor: Schedule & Covers, esa fecha, Change en la tarjeta del nino, y luego Cancelled. No uses Absent. Absent es la familia que falta a la sesion.
En Reason escribe que no hay instructor. No pidas que contesten en ese mensaje. Guarda. Solo ese dia se cancela. El servicio fijo se queda.
El padre recibe un WhatsApp automatico de que la sesion esta cancelada, con esa nota. Dice que el mensaje salio solo. La fila cae en Absents, refunds and credits.

Cuando la familia diga a la oficina refund o credit por otro lado, abre esa fila. Elige Credit o Refund, y luego Approve. En un refund pon el importe de la sesion. En un credit pon el mismo importe, o dejalo en blanco para un credito de sesion sin cifra.
Approve escribe el libro de la familia y manda el mensaje del resultado. Makeup solo si piden otro dia.
tips: Las faltas y cancelaciones de septiembre en adelante comparten una sola cola de decision.
Los mensajes automaticos de la API (cambio de instructor, cambio de hora, cancelacion, makeup confirmado) dicen que salieron solos. No pidas al padre que conteste ahi.

Cancelacion de pago privado por adelantado: lo no usado se puede devolver con una tasa del 10% de lo no usado (minimo 25 libras, maximo 100). Las sesiones ya dadas, incluido un crash de verano, siguen pagadas. LA / NHS no usan esta tasa.

Cancelar la plaza fija es Edit term slot. Pon el ancla en una fecha de ese dia de la semana, y luego Rest of term from the anchor. El reembolso que se le dijo al padre queda en ese participante, Payments, Cancel refund, y en este libro. Mark paid back cuando ese dinero ya ha vuelto. La fila de programme payments sigue mostrando lo que pagaron.

lessons.title: Cancel a makeup and give a new one
lessons.summary: Makeup grants live on Absents, refunds and credits. Schedule and Covers shows the seat only after the family accepts and it is on the roster.
lessons.where: Absents, refunds and credits → Makeup grants
steps: Open Absents, refunds and credits, then Makeup grants. The grant is not a row on Schedule and Covers until the family accepts it.
While the status is Open: Offer slot to name a day, or Cancel grant to drop it. Then Add makeup to issue a new open grant, and Offer slot again.
While the status is Offered (the family has not accepted yet): Withdraw offer to take the day back, or Cancel grant. The grant returns to Open so you can offer another day.

When the family Accepts in the parent portal, the makeup is written onto that day's roster. The grant then says On roster. Sessions Overview and Staff show that card on the makeup date. The admin bell shows Makeup accepted. A reply on WhatsApp does not accept.

On roster has no Cancel grant. To drop that one day, open Schedule and Covers on the makeup date, Change on that card, then Undo change. Do not use Cancelled: that sends a cancellation and opens a new Absents row.

The old On roster grant cannot be offered again. Add makeup for a new open grant, then Offer slot. Date is YYYY-MM-DD, time like 6 to 6.30, instructor name required. The new day paints on Schedule and Covers when the family Accepts.
tips: Back to decide is only while the grant is still Open or Offered. On roster does not go back to the decide queue. Undo that day on Schedule and Covers, then Add makeup.
Move to another slot today only moves inside that same date. Another week is Undo on the old day, then a new grant and Offer slot.

Add makeup: type the first letters of the name, pick the centre, then an open seat (their instructor or another instructor) and the day. Send to parent. They Accept or Decline in the parent portal. The seat is not on the roster until they Accept.
If a makeup was placed on a seat that is not on that day's roster, Schedule and Covers still shows that name so you can open Change and Undo change.

lessons.title: Programme payments (from the photo)
lessons.summary: The header photo opens Settings. Programme payments is the term-fees grid, one row per family. It is the Clients Payments sheet, not Create invoice.
lessons.where: Settings, then Programme payments. Also under Finance.
steps: The photo in the header opens Settings. It is not your profile and it does not open this grid by itself.
On Settings, under Programme money, open Outstanding, Payment rows, or the Programme payments button. That is this screen.
One row per family for the term: pay method, cost, sessions, invoice, billed, paid, still owed, and funding (LA invoice, NHS, private, Direct Payment).
The number next to Clients Payments is how many rows are in the table.
Create invoice and Xero are a different Finance screen. This grid is the spreadsheet mirror.
tips: Back to dashboard returns to the Operations Hub.

es.title: Programme payments (desde la foto)
es.summary: La foto del header abre Settings. Programme payments es la tabla de cuotas del termino, una fila por familia. Es la hoja Clients Payments, no Create invoice.
es.where: Settings, luego Programme payments. Tambien en Finance.
steps: La foto del header abre Settings. No es tu perfil y no abre esta tabla sola.
En Settings, en Programme money, abre Outstanding, Payment rows o el boton Programme payments. Esa es esta pantalla.
Una fila por familia del termino: metodo de pago, coste, sesiones, factura, facturado, pagado, lo que falta, y funding (LA invoice, NHS, private, Direct Payment).
El numero junto a Clients Payments es cuantas filas hay en la tabla.
Create invoice y Xero son otra pantalla de Finance. Esta tabla es el espejo de la hoja.
tips: Back to dashboard vuelve al Operations Hub.

lessons.title: Settings from the photo is shortcuts
lessons.summary: The header photo opens Settings. The money tiles and most buttons already live in Today, Finance or H&R. A few old tools only open from this page.
lessons.where: Header photo, or Settings in the left menu
steps: Outstanding, Programme money, Payment rows and LA / NHS rows open Finance, Payments. That is the Programme payments grid.
Open incidents opens Today, Incidents. Absents pending opens Finance, Absent, credits and refunds. Late approvals opens H&R, Late feedback.
Device notifications is also in the Settings menu. Log out is there too.
Send test WhatsApp on this page is a test. Family messages are P, staff messages are S, and Business is the green button.
Orders catalogue, Ops comms and log, Activity log, Change log, Training progress and Report generator are only linked from this page. They are not in the left menu.
Connections and Data exports loaded in this browser are a technical snapshot of this login. They are not a daily screen.
tips: You do not need the duplicate tiles for day-to-day work. Use Today, Finance and H&R.

es.title: Settings desde la foto son atajos
es.summary: La foto del header abre Settings. Las cajas de dinero y casi todos los botones ya estan en Today, Finance o H&R. Unos pocos tools viejos solo se abren desde esta pagina.
es.where: Foto del header, o Settings en el menu de la izquierda
steps: Outstanding, Programme money, Payment rows y LA / NHS rows abren Finance, Payments. Esa es la tabla Programme payments.
Open incidents abre Today, Incidents. Absents pending abre Finance, Absent, credits and refunds. Late approvals abre H&R, Late feedback.
Device notifications tambien esta en el menu Settings. Log out tambien.
Send test WhatsApp en esta pagina es una prueba. Los mensajes de familia son P, los de staff son S, y Business es el boton verde.
Orders catalogue, Ops comms and log, Activity log, Change log, Training progress y Report generator solo estan enlazados desde esta pagina. No estan en el menu de la izquierda.
Connections y Data exports loaded in this browser son una foto tecnica de este login. No es una pantalla del dia.
tips: No hace falta usar las cajas repetidas para el dia a dia. Usa Today, Finance y H&R.

categories.title: Messages
categories.blurb: Parent WhatsApp / notify, staff announcements and broadcasts.

lessons.title: Parent notify / WhatsApp
lessons.summary: Send approved template updates (payment, absence, makeup drafts, etc.).
lessons.where: Communications → Parent notify / Staff WhatsApp tools
steps: Open the parent notify or WhatsApp tool for the family.
Use an approved Meta template when WhatsApp requires it.
Preview the body; keep under template length limits.
Send and check the notify log if delivery fails.
tips: API WhatsApp number — not the company mobile.
Template portal_parent_update covers common drafts.

es.title: Avisos a padres / WhatsApp
es.summary: Envia plantillas aprobadas (pago, falta, borradores de makeup, etc.).
es.where: Communications → Parent notify / herramientas de WhatsApp de staff
steps: Abre parent notify o la herramienta de WhatsApp de esa familia.
Usa una plantilla Meta aprobada cuando WhatsApp la pida.
Revisa el texto. Respeta el largo de la plantilla.
Envia y mira el registro de avisos si no llega.
tips: El numero de WhatsApp API no es el movil de la empresa.
La plantilla portal_parent_update cubre los borradores habituales.

lessons.title: Staff announcements / reminders
lessons.summary: Workers must confirm pending announcements before using the app.
steps: Press A in the top bar. That opens Announcements. It is not in the left menu.
Compose the announcement or reminder.
Pick audience (group roster shows who is in the group).
Publish — staff see a blocking sheet until they confirm.
Use reminders for time-bound nags.
tips: Audience is admin/staff — not parents.
Schedule changes and outstanding feedback use the logo halo and Quick menu. They are not a blocking Sign and submit sheet.

lessons.title: Feedback WhatsApp clock
lessons.summary: Monday to Friday the reminder is 8:00pm then 8:30pm. Sunday is 6:00pm then 6:30pm. Saturday is 3:00pm then 3:30pm.
lessons.where: Automatic WhatsApp to staff who still owe Today's session feedback
steps: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday: first WhatsApp at 8:00pm, second at 8:30pm if feedback is still missing.
Sunday: first WhatsApp at 6:00pm, second at 6:30pm if feedback is still missing.
Saturday: first WhatsApp at 3:00pm, second at 3:30pm if feedback is still missing.
The API messages use the staff WhatsApp template. They say the message was sent automatically and not to reply. The link is the staff portal at clubsensational-staff.
The second API message goes only to people who still owe feedback.

30 minutes after that last API message, if the feedback is still missing, the staff phone gets the same locked-phone ring as a call. It comes back every 10 minutes until the feedback is in, and it stops at 11:00pm. Saturday that starts at 4:00pm. Sunday at 7:00pm. Monday to Friday at 9:00pm. The admin can still open WhatsApp Business on this computer. That chat does not send itself.
tips: Saturday is 3:00pm then 3:30pm. Sunday is 6:00pm then 6:30pm. Weekdays stay 8:00pm then 8:30pm. The locked-phone ring starts 30 minutes after the second API message and repeats every 10 minutes until the feedback is in, or until 11:00pm.

es.title: Reloj del WhatsApp de feedback
es.summary: De lunes a viernes el aviso es a las 8:00 y a las 8:30. El domingo es a las 6:00 y a las 6:30. El sabado es a las 3:00 y a las 3:30.
es.where: WhatsApp automatico al staff que aun debe el feedback de hoy
steps: Lunes, martes, miercoles, jueves y viernes: primer WhatsApp a las 8:00, segundo a las 8:30 si el feedback sigue sin hacerse.
Domingo: primer WhatsApp a las 6:00, segundo a las 6:30 si el feedback sigue sin hacerse.
Sabado: primer WhatsApp a las 3:00, segundo a las 3:30 si el feedback sigue sin hacerse.
Los mensajes de API usan la plantilla de WhatsApp del staff. Dicen que se envio automaticamente y que no contesten. El enlace es el portal de staff en clubsensational-staff.
El segundo mensaje de API solo sale a quien todavia debe feedback.

30 minutos despues de ese ultimo mensaje de API, si el feedback sigue sin hacerse, el movil del staff recibe el mismo aviso que una llamada, aunque este bloqueado. Vuelve cada 10 minutos hasta que el feedback esta dentro, y para a las 11:00. El sabado empieza a las 4:00. El domingo a las 7:00. De lunes a viernes a las 9:00. El admin puede abrir WhatsApp Business en este ordenador. Ese chat no se envia solo.
tips: Sabado a las 3:00 y a las 3:30. Domingo a las 6:00 y a las 6:30. Entre semana a las 8:00 y a las 8:30. El aviso del movil bloqueado empieza 30 minutos despues del segundo mensaje de API y se repite cada 10 minutos hasta que el feedback esta dentro, o hasta las 11:00.

lessons.title: Incoming staff call shows who is calling
lessons.summary: The ring card names the caller. It does not say only Worker calling ADMIN.
lessons.where: Admin, CEO, office or staff dashboard — incoming call card
steps: When a call rings, the title stays Incoming call.
The line under it is the caller's first name, for example Emmanuel is calling.
The same name shows inside Communications when you answer there.
Refresh the dashboard if an old card is still on screen from before this change.
tips: Office calling a worker also shows that person's name, not a blank Worker label.

lessons.title: Delete a staff chat message
lessons.summary: Remove a message you sent in Communications. It leaves the chat for you and for the other person.
steps: Open Communications and the conversation.
On a message you sent, press Delete under the time.
Confirm Delete this message for everyone.
The message disappears from the chat. A phone notification that already arrived stays on the phone.
tips: You can only delete messages you sent, including ones you sent as ADMIN.
Calls cannot be deleted this way.

lessons.title: Green light, admin bar, and read
lessons.summary: The green dot in Communications is not the same as STAFF on the admin bar. Delivered is not read.
steps: STAFF on the admin bar lists people who have the staff app open. Communications alone does not put them there.
The green dot next to a name in Communications means that person has the Communications page open right now.
Delivered means their Communications page received the message.
Read means they opened this conversation with the screen in front. Opening another chat, or leaving this one in the background, stays on delivered.
Read is green. The time beside it is when they opened this conversation.
tips: A green dot with delivered, not read, means the chat app is open and this conversation has not been opened.
On the same day the read time is only the clock, for example read 11:20. Another day also shows the date.

lessons.title: Staff chat does not ping the phone
lessons.summary: Communications messages stay unread when the worker is in the app but phone notifications are off.
lessons.where: Staff app, Quick menu, Alerts & notifications
steps: The worker opens the CS Portal icon on the iPhone home screen.
Quick menu, then Alerts & notifications.
Press Turn on portal features, or Turn on notifications, and tap Allow.
If the phone does not ask: iPhone Settings, Notifications, CS Portal, Allow Notifications. Then open the app again.
tips: A message shows read only after they open that conversation. Being on the staff home screen does not mark it read.
WhatsApp and a phone call still reach them when this permission is off.

categories.title: H&R
categories.blurb: Formal workers, timetable, Documents, Finance and Policies. Onboarding and interviews are under Potential workers.

lessons.title: Late feedback and timesheet pay
lessons.summary: Staff can send late feedback without approval. This page holds the day for pay until you Release it.
steps: Open H&R, then Late feedback. The title row has the info button and Back to H&R.
Late means the feedback was completed after the session London day, or on the same day after 21:00.
Staff do not need approval to submit session feedback or a cancellation. The day stays on hold for timesheet pay until you press Release.
Release does not cut the pay. It only clears the hold. Release all clears every waiting day for that worker.
Last 60 days, Prev week, This week, Next week and Refresh change which days you see.
Incident late approvals, at the bottom, are only for past-session incidents.
tips: A one-day absence is not this page. That stays in Absents, credits and refunds.

es.title: Late feedback y el pago del timesheet
es.summary: El equipo puede enviar el feedback tarde sin aprobacion. Esta pagina retiene el dia para el pago hasta que pulses Release.
steps: Abre H&R y luego Late feedback. La fila del titulo lleva el boton de info y Back to H&R.
Late es un feedback cerrado despues del dia de la sesion en Londres, o el mismo dia despues de las 21:00.
No hace falta aprobacion para el feedback de la sesion ni para una cancelacion. El dia queda retenido para el pago del timesheet hasta que pulses Release.
Release no quita el pago. Solo suelta la retencion. Release all suelta todos los dias pendientes de ese trabajador.
Last 60 days, Prev week, This week, Next week y Refresh cambian los dias que ves.
Incident late approvals, abajo, es solo para incidentes de una sesion ya pasada.
tips: La falta de un dia no es esta pagina. Eso sigue en Absents, credits and refunds.

lessons.title: Documents, Finance and Policies
lessons.summary: H&R lists three screens. Each screen has buttons to move between what is inside.
steps: Open H&R. Under Files you see Documents, Finance, Policies, and Day Centre documents.
Documents is the worker files. The buttons on that page switch Timesheets, Expenses, Checklists, Passports, Certificates, First aid and the rest.
Finance is pay. The buttons switch Timesheets, Payslips, Expenses, Pay rates and Payroll.
If an expense is still pending payment, a number sits on the Finance button and on Expenses. It stays until you mark it paid.
Policies switches between the Policies portal and Policy sign-offs.
tips: Certificates and passports are buttons inside Documents. They are not separate lines in the menu.

es.title: Documents, Finance y Policies
es.summary: H&R tiene tres pantallas. Cada una lleva botones para moverse por lo que hay dentro.
steps: Abre H&R. En Files estan Documents, Finance, Policies y Day Centre documents.
Documents son los archivos del trabajador. Los botones cambian Timesheets, Expenses, Checklists, Passports, Certificates, First aid y el resto.
Finance es el pago. Los botones cambian Timesheets, Payslips, Expenses, Pay rates y Payroll.
Si un gasto sigue pendiente de pago, sale un numero en el boton Finance y en Expenses. Se queda hasta que lo marcas pagado.
Policies cambia entre Policies portal y Policy sign-offs.
tips: Certificates y passports son botones dentro de Documents. No son lineas sueltas del menu.

lessons.title: Timetable (staff hours / rota)
lessons.summary: Who works which hours. Does not change who is booked as a client.
steps: Open Timetable / Who works for the week.
Read instructor hours for each day — this gates timesheet and standing projection.
Click a participant name only if you need Edit term slot for booked kids — that is a different tool.
One-day staff cover for sessions still goes through Schedule & Covers.
tips: Timetable = workers. Edit term slot = client seats. Schedule & Covers = one-day exceptions.
To add a worker on a weekday for the rest of term: open that weekday, set their hours (for example 11-3 Day Centre), and save. Then put them on the child's seat with Edit term slot.

lessons.title: Staff roster and profiles
lessons.summary: Browse workers, open a profile, check onboarding.
steps: Open Workers under H&R, Formal workers. Each row shows that worker's own photo.
Onboarding and Interviews are under Potential workers, not Formal workers.
Shifts, services, days on rota and venues are this week's Autumn timetable. Days off are the dates already requested.
Open a worker for profile and employment tools.
Job application and Health questionnaire on that card are the forms they already filled. Bank account is its own section. Employee info stays the short working record.
Use Potential workers, then Onboarding, for new-hire progress.
Contracts / training / uniform live under the same H&R card.
tips: Staff login host is clubsensational-staff — not the family site.
Documents only keeps My Documents. Full opens the staff dashboard, Today and feedback. Change it on the worker profile, then they sign in again.
A dash means that worker is not on the timetable this week. Job-form availability stays on the worker card, not in the shifts column.

lessons.title: Parents teleport
lessons.summary: Look at a family portal without their PIN and without signing them out.
steps: Open Parents teleport on Frequent.
Search the parent, the child, or the email.
Click View portal. The family home opens on this screen in ghost view.
You can look at sessions, invoices and the hub. Paying, absences, messages and PIN changes stay blocked.
Click Close to leave. Their own login on their phone stays open. They do not appear on the PARENT online chip.
tips: This is the same idea as Dashboard teleport for staff.
The ghost view lasts about 30 minutes. Open it again if it expires.

lessons.title: Interviews: Successful and Unsuccessful
lessons.summary: Interviews has two lists. Successful is passed, on hold, shadowing, or already staff. Unsuccessful is a failed interview or a cancelled offer.
steps: Successful: they passed. The stage shows Staff with normal pay, Shadowing, or Successful while onboarding is still open.
The days and the rate are not chosen on this list. Open H&R, Finance, Pay rates.
On that person choose Normal pay, or Shadowing. Shadowing is £13.50. Set Normal pay from for the first day at the rate on the card. Leave the date empty to keep every day at £13.50.
Unsuccessful: the call or face interview failed, or they cancelled the offer. They are not called as a hire.
Did not join is its own list, under Successful. It is for someone who passed and then did not continue, or never finished onboarding. The review is Other job. It is not Unsuccessful.
tips: On hold stays under Successful. The next step says when to call again.
Someone already working is Staff, not still on the onboarding checklist.
Did not join switches off the staff login and takes them off the Onboarding PIN list.

lessons.title: Stage 1 call interview (three phases)
lessons.summary: The phone interview is three phases. Record each phase here, or attach a file if the call happened somewhere else. No stars on this stage.
lessons.where: Interviews → open the candidate → Stage 1 call
steps: Phase 1 — Getting to know the candidate: five questions, then explain who clubSENsational is, who we support, activities, venues, how we work, and what is different.

Phase 2 — Practical suitability: availability, travel, start date and notice, anything that would block the role or a face-to-face interview. Then explain the role, pay, shadowing, DBS, and Stage 2 including a wet session when the role needs it.
Phase 3 — Confirming understanding: happy with the role and pay, happy with shadowing and the shadowing rate, comfortable with Stage 2 (wet session when relevant), and any questions they have.
Use Record this phase on each phase. If the call was made on another phone, use Attach recording for that phase.
Notes stay under each question. Stage 1 has no star ratings.
Stage 2 face-to-face still uses its own questions and stars.
tips: If the microphone is blocked, attach the recording file. Do not expect a size-limit alert.
Save after notes or a recording so it stays on the candidate.

lessons.title: See what a new hire has done of induction
lessons.summary: Induction is complete only when all 6 modules have a real quiz pass. A recap diploma or an automatic stamp is not completion.
steps: Open Training progress (Staff Readiness) and find the worker.
Read the module chips and the count, for example 2 of 6 modules.
Treat it as complete only when 6 modules show a real quiz pass.
A recap button or a diploma does not mean the 6 modules are done.
No contract card appears for the worker until admin generates the contract.
tips: Completed modules stay saved. Refreshing the page does not wipe a real pass.
New hires who must finish induction do not get the recap diploma path.

lessons.title: Staff portal search
lessons.summary: Search is the first button in the staff Quick menu. It finds a page and opens it.
steps: On the staff app, open Quick menu. Search is the first button, at the top.
Type the page. Timesheet, time sheet, session disruption, day off, expenses, policies, payslip and comms all match.
Tap Open. That opens the same screen as the Quick menu button.
A page that is hidden for that worker does not appear. Leads-only tools stay hidden for everyone else.
tips: Search does not book a place and does not change Today.

es.title: Buscador del portal de staff
es.summary: Search es el primer boton del Quick menu de staff. Encuentra una pagina y la abre.
es.where: Portal de staff, Quick menu, arriba
steps: En la app de staff, abre Quick menu. Search es el primer boton, arriba del todo.
Escribe la pagina. Timesheet, time sheet, session disruption, day off, expenses, policies, payslip y comms coinciden.
Pulsa Open. Abre la misma pantalla que el boton del Quick menu.
Una pagina oculta para ese trabajador no sale. Las herramientas solo de leads siguen ocultas para el resto.
tips: Search no reserva una plaza y no cambia Today.

lessons.title: What runs by itself
lessons.summary: The CEO page lists the jobs the portal does without a button: clocks, payments, and pushes.
lessons.where: CEO portal, Company insights, What runs by itself
steps: Open the CEO portal.
Under Company insights, open What runs by itself.
Read English and Spanish on the same page.

On a clock: pay hold every 2 minutes, trial offers every 10 minutes, own-arrangement buffer about 06:00, office missing-feedback push at 21:00, staff feedback WhatsApp at 20:00 and 20:30 on weekdays, 18:00 and 18:30 on Sunday, 15:00 and 15:30 on Saturday, timesheet WhatsApp at 23:00 on the 24th, parent weekly notes Tuesday evening and Saturday morning.
When something happens: Stripe or GoCardless payment finishes the booking path. A saved cover or schedule change pushes staff. Outstanding feedback lights the halo. It does not lock the app.
A new place, New client, a cover, a day off, an invoice, Xero products, an announcement and Family broadcast still need a person.
tips: The page explains the jobs. It does not start them or stop them.
Pay hold, trial offers, the 06:00 buffer and the 21:00 office push are on the saved clock. Staff feedback WhatsApp is on. The timesheet reminder and weekly notes are built for those times.
The 15 Aug 2026 unpaid release and the 26 Jun 2026 payroll email are finished. They do not repeat.

es.title: Lo que corre solo
es.summary: La pagina del CEO lista los trabajos que el portal hace sin un boton: relojes, pagos y avisos.
es.where: Portal CEO, Company insights, What runs by itself
steps: Abre el portal CEO.
En Company insights, abre What runs by itself.
Lee ingles y espanol en la misma pagina.

Con reloj: pay hold cada 2 minutos, ofertas de trial cada 10 minutos, buffer de own arrangement sobre las 06:00, push a la oficina del feedback que falta a las 21:00, WhatsApp de feedback al staff a las 20:00 y 20:30 entre semana, 18:00 y 18:30 el domingo, 15:00 y 15:30 el sabado, WhatsApp de timesheet a las 23:00 el dia 24, notas semanales de padres el martes por la tarde y el sabado por la manana.
Cuando pasa algo: un pago Stripe o GoCardless sigue el camino de cerrar la reserva. Un cover o cambio de horario guardado avisa al staff. El feedback pendiente enciende el halo. No bloquea la app.
Una plaza nueva, New client, un cover, un day off, una factura, productos de Xero, un anuncio y Family broadcast siguen necesitando una persona.
tips: La pagina explica los trabajos. No los enciende ni los apaga.

Pay hold, ofertas de trial, el buffer de las 06:00 y el push de las 21:00 estan en el reloj guardado. El WhatsApp de feedback al staff esta encendido. El timesheet y las notas semanales estan hechos para esas horas.
La suelta del 15 ago 2026 y el email de nomina del 26 jun 2026 ya terminaron. No se repiten.

lessons.title: Write and send in Communications
lessons.summary: The message box is a few lines tall. Enter starts a new line. Only the Send button sends.
steps: Open Communications and the conversation.
Write in the box. It shows several lines, so you can see the text.
Press Enter or Intro for a new line. On the phone that does not send.
Press Send to send the message.
tips: The same rule is on the computer and on the phone.

es.title: Escribir y enviar en Communications
es.summary: La caja del mensaje tiene varias lineas. Intro hace una linea nueva. Solo el boton Send envia.
steps: Abre Communications y la conversacion.
Escribe en la caja. Muestra varias lineas para que se vea el texto.
Intro hace una linea nueva. En el movil no envia.
Pulsa Send para enviar el mensaje.
tips: La misma regla vale en el ordenador y en el movil.

lessons.title: Admin Comms stays in admin
lessons.summary: The yellow C in the admin header opens Communications inside the admin page. The full screen with a way out is the staff app.
steps: In admin, tap the yellow C in the header.
Communications opens in the admin page, under the same header as P, S and A.
Leave it by opening another admin screen. There is no separate Communications page to exit.
On the staff app, C still opens the full Communications screen.
tips: A new Comms message toast in admin also opens inside admin.

es.title: Comms de admin se queda en admin
es.summary: La C amarilla del header de admin abre Communications dentro de la pagina de admin. La pantalla completa, con salida, es la app de staff.
steps: En admin, pulsa la C amarilla del header.
Communications se abre en la pagina de admin, bajo el mismo header que P, S y A.
Sales abriendo otra pantalla de admin. No hay una pagina aparte de Communications de la que salir.
En la app de staff, la C sigue abriendo la pantalla completa de Communications.
tips: Un aviso de mensaje nuevo de Comms en admin tambien se abre dentro de admin.

lessons.title: Workers list in Communications
lessons.summary: On ADMIN, the search box sits above Workers. Each row shows the first name and a larger photo.
steps: Open Communications and choose ADMIN.
The search box is above the Workers heading. Type at least two letters and press Enter.
Each worker row shows the first name only, with a larger photo.
Under the name, a chip shows the role: Swimming, Climbing, Support A&W, Support DC, Fitness, Admin, or Bank.
Groups under that list keep their full name.
tips: My account does not show this Workers search. It is the ADMIN list.

es.title: Lista de workers en Communications
es.summary: En ADMIN, el buscador esta encima de Workers. Cada fila muestra el nombre y una foto mas grande.
steps: Abre Communications y elige ADMIN.
El buscador esta encima de Workers. Escribe al menos dos letras y pulsa Enter.
Cada worker sale con el nombre, sin apellido, y con la foto mas grande.
Debajo del nombre hay un chip con el rol: Swimming, Climbing, Support A&W, Support DC, Fitness, Admin o Bank.
Los grupos de debajo conservan el nombre completo.
tips: My account no lleva este buscador de Workers. Es la lista de ADMIN.

lessons.title: Alerts bell is a popup
lessons.summary: The bell opens a large popup in the middle of admin. Each alert title and detail is big enough to read.
steps: Tap the bell in the admin header.
The alerts open in a popup over the page. The page behind goes dim.
Read the title and the detail on each row. Tap a row to open that screen.
Tap the dim area, or the bell again, to close the popup.
tips: The number on the bell is how many alerts are in the popup.
The bell keeps incidents, cancellations, wellbeing still open, same-day disruptions, late incident approvals, general-info updates, and a makeup only when that session is today or later.
A makeup whose session day has passed leaves the bell. Unpaid expenses are not in the bell. Their number is on Finance and on Expenses until you mark them paid.

es.title: La campana es un popup
es.summary: La campana abre un popup grande en el centro del admin. El titulo y el detalle de cada alerta se leen en grande.
steps: Pulsa la campana del header de admin.
Las alertas se abren en un popup encima de la pagina. El fondo se oscurece.
Lee el titulo y el detalle de cada fila. Pulsa una fila para abrir esa pantalla.
Pulsa la zona oscura, o la campana otra vez, para cerrar el popup.
tips: El numero de la campana es cuantas alertas hay en el popup.
La campana guarda incidentes, cancelaciones, wellbeing abierto, disruptions del dia, aprobaciones de incidentes tarde, cambios de general info, y un makeup solo si esa sesion es hoy o despues.
Un makeup de un dia que ya paso sale de la campana. Los gastos pendientes no van a la campana. El numero esta en Finance y en Expenses hasta que los marcas pagados.

lessons.title: Announcements like WhatsApp
lessons.summary: The red A opens announcements as conversations. Each group is a chat. Open a message to see who signed and who has not.
steps: Tap the red A in the admin header.
The left list is the groups the messages went to: All staff, Leads, a role, or one person.
Open a group. Each send is a message in that chat.
Tap a message. Signed and Not signed are on the same page.
Announcement and Reminder at the top start a new send. Edit changes the open message.
tips: Reminders use Marked read and Not marked. Announcements use Signed and Not signed.

es.title: Anuncios como WhatsApp
es.summary: La A roja abre los anuncios como conversaciones. Cada grupo es un chat. Abre un mensaje para ver quien firmo y quien no.
steps: Pulsa la A roja del header de admin.
La lista de la izquierda son los grupos a los que se mando: All staff, Leads, un rol, o una persona.
Abre un grupo. Cada envio es un mensaje de ese chat.
Pulsa un mensaje. Firmados y No firmados estan en la misma pagina.
Announcement y Reminder arriba empiezan un envio nuevo. Edit cambia el mensaje abierto.
tips: Los reminders dicen Marked read y Not marked. Los anuncios dicen Signed y Not signed.

lessons.title: What the timesheet counts
lessons.summary: Hours on the timesheet follow the shift and the feedbacks. You do not type granted hours by hand.
lessons.where: Staff app → Timesheet (admin reads the same rules)
steps: Today and later dates show as Upcoming. They are not completed and they are not ready to pay.

A weekday support / bespoke shift that is the 4.15-6.15 band is 2 hours. A Sunday support shift that is 5 hours shows 9.15-2.15. The time the child is actually there inside that band is not extra granted hours on top.
Shadowing and Training added in Schedule & Covers pay £13.50/h. On the timesheet the service stays the session name and Shadowing or Training is the role line.
Climbing (Carlos, Alex, and Andres when he covers Carlos) pays the feedbacks given that day. An hour with no participant is not paid.
Absent on Schedule & Covers means that session's feedback is done.
tips: Bespoke Programme shows as Bespoke.
If a timesheet was already downloaded with the wrong hours, ask them to submit again after a refresh. The new submit replaces the downloaded one.
On the 24th at 11pm London, WhatsApp reminds whoever has not submitted that cycle. Victor, Javi Palankas and Raul are not reminded. Andres, Angel and Giuseppe are not on payroll.
An afternoon-only day off (Northolt or Acton, not SwimFarm) keeps the morning session. If that morning has no feedback it stays Pending in orange.
Office, Interview and Manager do not need feedback. They must not leave the day orange when the child feedback is already in.
Michelle Day Centre is 10:45-4:15 (5.5h). That is her shift, not the children's 11:00-4:00 and not granted extra.

categories.title: Documents
categories.blurb: REGISTERED forms, consents, policies and worker uploads.

lessons.title: Registration Form
lessons.summary: Every Booking Portal form, including people already in class. Not the REGISTERED list, and not LEADS. The pack is the PDF, the photo, and the pay link.
steps: Open Registration Form under Documents. Each row is a form that came in through the Booking Portal. People already in class are on this table too. It is not the REGISTERED list under Services & places, and it is not LEADS.
New-client registration is the PDF and the photo, for the office to read. Parents finish funding and payment later on the finish-booking link.
Place is live only: REGISTERED only, WAITING, Pay hold, Awaiting Tide, In class, or Did not finish.
The chosen slot is not on this table. It arrives in the pay-hold alert and the I have paid office alert.
After a bank transfer the parent must WhatsApp or email the office. A tap alone does not change admin.
Then check Tide, Mark paid in Re-enrolments and Bookings, and send the PIN.
Mark reviewed means you opened the PDF. Resend finish link if they lost it.
Climbing forms and Parent consents are under Clients & Families, Documents. Registration Form is there too.
Do not show them as booked kids on Sessions until they are a CLIENT.
tips: REGISTERED under Services & places is only people who finished the form and have never had a place. LEADS started OTP and did not finish the form. Climbing registrations and Parent consents stay under Documents.

es.title: Registration Form
es.summary: Todos los formularios del Booking Portal, tambien gente que ya esta en clase. No es la lista REGISTERED, y no es LEADS. El paquete es el PDF, la foto y el enlace de pago.
steps: Abre Registration Form en Documents. Cada fila es un formulario que entro por el Booking Portal. La gente que ya esta en clase tambien sale aqui. No es la lista REGISTERED de Services & places, y no es LEADS.
El registro de cliente nuevo es el PDF y la foto, para que la oficina los lea. El padre termina funding y pago despues, en el enlace de finish-booking.
Place es solo el estado vivo: REGISTERED only, WAITING, Pay hold, Awaiting Tide, In class, o Did not finish.
La franja elegida no esta en esta tabla. Llega en el aviso de pay-hold y en el aviso de oficina I have paid.
Despues de una transferencia el padre tiene que escribir por WhatsApp o email a la oficina. Un toque solo no cambia el admin.
Luego mira Tide, Mark paid en Re-enrolments and Bookings, y manda el PIN.
Mark reviewed quiere decir que abriste el PDF. Resend finish link si lo perdieron.
Climbing forms y Parent consents estan en Clients & Families, Documents. Registration Form tambien esta ahi.
No los pongas como ninos reservados en Sessions hasta que sean CLIENT.
tips: REGISTERED en Services & places es solo gente que termino el formulario y nunca ha tenido plaza. LEADS pidio OTP y no termino el formulario. Climbing registrations y Parent consents se quedan en Documents.

lessons.title: Consents and policies
lessons.summary: Parent consents are only for ACTIVE clients. Annual renewal stays empty until a signature is older than 12 months.
lessons.where: Clients & Families → Documents → Parent consents / Climbing. Policies are under H&R → Documents.
steps: Open Parent consents. The list is ACTIVE clients only.
The top chips are Status, Photo, Medication, Emergency and Travel. The row under the chip you pick filters only that area.
Pending means they have not signed yet.
Annual renewal means they signed and that signature is older than 12 months. If nobody is there, nobody is due yet.
REGISTERED, WAITING and people who are not clients do not see Consents in the parent portal until they are ACTIVE.
tips: ACAT is a group seat. It does not appear on Parent consents. Each child in that group appears with their own parent.

lessons.title: DBS and Safeguarding certificate
lessons.summary: Attach a worker DBS or Safeguarding certificate so it shows in My Documents.
steps: Open Documents and use Attach file for worker.
Search the worker, then set Document type to DBS or Safeguarding certificate.
Add a title, choose the PDF or photo, and press Attach to My Documents.
The worker sees it under My Documents, Training.
tips: DBS is its own type. Do not file it as a generic Certificate.
Safeguarding certificate is the training file, not the policy sign-off.

lessons.title: Hire photo: original and display
lessons.summary: The hire uploads the original. The office cleans it. Families, staff and admin see only the cleaned photo.
steps: Open Potential workers, then Onboarding.
The face in Photo is the original upload. Click it to open the full picture.
Press Edit. Clean background removes the background, puts the grey, and centers the face.
Nudge the face if needed, then Save display photo.
That saved photo is the one in admin, the staff portal and the parent portal. Staff cannot change it themselves.
tips: The upload and the photo parents see are two files. Do not send the original to families.
A dash means they have not uploaded one. Display next to the face means the cleaned photo is saved.

es.title: Foto del hire: original y la que se ensena
es.summary: El hire sube la original. La oficina la limpia. Familias, staff y admin ven solo la foto limpia.
steps: Abre Potential workers y luego Onboarding.
La cara en Photo es la original. Pulsala para abrirla entera.
Pulsa Edit. Clean background quita el fondo, pone el gris y centra la cara.
Mueve la cara si hace falta y pulsa Save display photo.
Esa foto guardada es la de admin, el staff portal y el parent portal. El staff no puede cambiarla.
tips: La que suben y la que ven los padres son dos fotos. No ensenes la original a las familias.
Una raya quiere decir que no han subido foto. Display al lado de la cara quiere decir que la limpia ya esta guardada.

lessons.title: Right to work
lessons.summary: Keep share-code screenshots and visa proof under Right to work, not Passport.
lessons.where: Documents → Attach file for worker, or Onboarding → Documents
steps: Open Documents and use Attach file for worker.
Search the worker, then set Document type to Right to work.
Add a title, choose the PDF or photo, and press Attach to My Documents.
The worker sees it under My Documents, Documents.
New hires can also use Upload right to work in the onboarding hub.
tips: A gov.uk right to work screenshot is not a passport.
British / UK nationals can skip this if the passport is already uploaded.

lessons.title: How document names show
lessons.summary: Every file in Documents is named Person - Document.ext.
steps: Open Documents.
Each row is the worker full name, a hyphen, then the document, then the file type.
Examples: Michelle Caleb - Starter Checklist.jpg, Michelle Caleb - Passport.jpg, Michelle Caleb - September Expenses.pdf.
tips: Expenses use the month. Timesheets keep the date range.
A camera filename is replaced by this name in the list and on download.

lessons.title: Mark an expense paid
lessons.summary: Paid keeps the date you validated it, so payroll can be tracked later.
steps: Open Documents and filter Expenses.
Pending means it is not in payroll yet.
Press Mark paid when you have paid and validated it.
The Pay column then shows Paid and the date of that day.
tips: Mark unpaid clears the date if it was marked by mistake.
The date is the day you pressed Mark paid, not the expense month.

categories.title: Map of portals
categories.blurb: Which site is which - admin, CEO, staff, parent, booking - and the island map.

lessons.title: Admin vs staff vs parent vs booking
lessons.summary: Never send staff to the family site or parents to the staff app.
steps: Admin / office (this app): portalvic.vercel.app — Overview, Finance, Schedule, H&R.
Staff app: clubsensational-staff.vercel.app — login, Today, timesheet, onboarding.
Parent hub: www.clubsensational.org/parent — chips, Team, invoices for families.
Booking: www.clubsensational.org/bookingportal — places offer for families.
tips: New-hire invite emails use the staff host, not portalvic or clubsensational.org home.

lessons.title: CEO menu and what left Settings
lessons.summary: Staff readiness, Activity log and Portal activity are on the CEO menu. Alerts and Office help stay in the top bar.
lessons.where: CEO portal menu, and admin top bar
steps: Open the CEO portal. Under Company insights is Activity log. Next to Parents in portal is Portal activity, then Staff readiness.
Those three open the same admin screens. They are not in the admin Settings menu.
Alerts inbox is the bell in the admin top bar. It is not a Settings item.
Office help is the link on Operations Hub and the i on each page. It is not a Settings item.
Settings still has Settings, Staff push devices, Device notifications, the other portals, and Log out.

lessons.title: Booking Portal: who is connected, and the 30-minute hold
lessons.summary: The booking page shows the family account at the top. An unpaid finish link holds the seat for 30 minutes, then the seat goes live again.
steps: Open Booking Portal. The top bar says Connected as the parent name and email, or Not signed in.
Sign in is the welcome popup (family PIN or email code). Sign out clears that browser and asks again.
Clients and former families both see their own name. A former label only means they are not in class yet.
When a registration finishes, the pay link holds that seat for 30 minutes. If they do not pay, the hold expires and the seat is free on the offer again.
Do not send a second hold while they are about to pay. A second hold paints the seat full before payment.
tips: If the top bar shows another family, Sign out before booking. The slot link does not switch the account by itself.
Fully booked with no payment usually means the 30-minute hold has not been cleared yet.

lessons.title: CS World
lessons.summary: Settings, CS World. Seven squares and the lines that light when one portal tells another.
steps: Open Settings, then CS World. The page is portal_world.html on the admin host.
Seven squares: CEO, Automatizaciones, Onboarding, Booking, Admin, Staff and Parent.
Pick a world first (Booking, Automatizaciones, Admin, Staff, Parent, Onboarding, CEO). Then pick a path in that world. The gold line lights and a point travels to the portal that gets told.
Booking pagado: the point leaves Booking, passes Automatizaciones, and arrives at Admin, Staff and Parent together.
OTP email starts in Booking, where the family asks for the code. Automatizaciones sends that email. A brand new lead also alerts Admin. It does not rewrite Staff or Parent.
Pausa holds the step. Click a step to read it. Click a square to leave the path and read only that square.
The side panel holds the words. The squares stay clear.
tips: The paths show how the portals talk. They are not today's live log.
Onboarding and Staff share the staff host and the same account. Parents never open that host.
Soft hold after a trial blocks that seat on Booking until the end of that London day. The 30 minute hold is the unpaid pay link. They are not the same.

Around the portals: Stripe is the card, GoCardless is the monthly charge, Xero keeps the invoice draft, email sends the OTP, WhatsApp is Business plus the Parents and Staff APIs, and Comms is the in-app call. Comms is not WhatsApp.

es.title: CS World
es.summary: Settings, CS World. Siete cuadros y las lineas que se encienden cuando un portal avisa a otro.
steps: Abre Settings y luego CS World. La pagina es portal_world.html en el host de admin.
Siete cuadros: CEO, Automatizaciones, Onboarding, Booking, Admin, Staff y Parent.
Elige primero un mundo (Booking, Automatizaciones, Admin, Staff, Parent, Onboarding, CEO). Luego un camino de ese mundo. La linea dorada se enciende y el punto viaja hasta el portal que se entera.
Booking pagado: el punto sale de Booking, pasa por Automatizaciones y llega a la vez a Admin, Staff y Parent.
El email de OTP empieza en Booking, donde la familia pide el codigo. Automatizaciones manda ese email. Si el lead es nuevo, Admin recibe un aviso. No reescribe Staff ni Parent.
Pausa deja el paso quieto. Pulsa un paso para leerlo. Pulsa un cuadro para salir del camino y leer solo ese cuadro.
El texto va en el panel. Los cuadros se quedan libres.
tips: Los caminos ensenan como se hablan los portales. No son el parte de hoy.
Onboarding y Staff comparten el host de staff y la misma cuenta. Los padres no entran ahi.
El soft hold de un trial ocupa la plaza en Booking hasta el final de ese dia en Londres. El hold de 30 minutos es el enlace de pago sin cobrar. No son lo mismo.

Alrededor: Stripe es la tarjeta, GoCardless es la cuota mensual, Xero guarda el borrador de la factura, el email manda el OTP, WhatsApp es Business mas las APIs de Parents y Staff, y Comms es la llamada dentro del portal. Comms no es WhatsApp.
